newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-,4-week discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Friday's auctions of Bulgarian Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 1.27 percent and 6.38 percent respectively, down from 1.48 and 7.75 percent at Thursday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 57.877 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 53.382 billion levs worth.
The issues were offered with par values of 25 billion levs and 40 billion levs respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance. Auction date and issue date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 25,000 million levs 40,000 million levs
Bids received 13,382.3 million levs 44,494.6 million levs
Bids approved 13,382.3 million levs 40,000 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.27 pct 6.38 pct
